an5.166:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi …pe…
an5.166:1.2: idhāvuso, bhikkhu sīlasampanno samādhisampanno paññāsampanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyyapi vuṭṭhaheyya’pi
an5.166:1.4: no ce diṭṭheva dhamme aññaṃ ārādheyya, atikkammeva kabaliṅkārāhārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyya’pi vuṭṭhaheyya’pi
an5.166:2.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā udāyī āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca:
an5.166:2.2: “aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ āvuso, sāriputta, anavakāso yaṃ so bhikkhu atikkammeva kabaliṅkārāhārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyyapi vuṭṭhaheyyapi
an5.166:3.1: dutiyampi kho …pe… tatiyampi kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi:
an5.166:3.2: “idhāvuso, bhikkhu sīlasampanno samādhisampanno paññāsampanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyyapi vuṭṭhaheyyapi
an5.166:3.4: no ce diṭṭheva dhamme aññaṃ ārādheyya, atikkammeva kabaliṅkārāhārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyyapi vuṭṭhaheyyapi
an5.166:4.1: tatiyampi kho āyasmā udāyī āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca:
an5.166:4.2: “aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ āvuso, sāriputta, anavakāso yaṃ so bhikkhu atikkammeva kabaliṅkārāhārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyyapi vuṭṭhaheyyapi
an5.166:5.2: yāva tatiyampi kho me āyasmā udāyī paṭikkosati, na ca me koci bhikkhu anumodati.
an5.166:5.4: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an5.166:5.5: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi:
an5.166:5.6: “idhāvuso, bhikkhu sīlasampanno samādhisampanno paññāsampanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyyapi vuṭṭhaheyyapi
an5.166:5.8: no ce diṭṭheva dhamme aññaṃ ārādheyya, atikkammeva kabaliṅkārāhārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyyapi vuṭṭhaheyyapi
an5.166:6.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā udāyī āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca:
an5.166:6.2: “aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ āvuso, sāriputta, anavakāso yaṃ so bhikkhu atikkammeva kabaliṅkārāhārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyyapi vuṭṭhaheyyapi
an5.166:7.1: dutiyampi kho …pe… tatiyampi kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhu āmantesi:
an5.166:7.2: “idhāvuso, bhikkhu sīlasampanno samādhisampanno paññāsampanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyyapi vuṭṭhaheyyapi
an5.166:7.4: no ce diṭṭheva dhamme aññaṃ ārādheyya, atikkammeva kabaliṅkārāhārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyyapi vuṭṭhaheyyapi
an5.166:8.1: tatiyampi kho āyasmā udāyī āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca:
an5.166:8.2: “aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ āvuso, sāriputta, anavakāso yaṃ so bhikkhu atikkammeva kabaliṅkārāhārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyyapi vuṭṭhaheyyapi
an5.166:9.2: bhagavatopi kho me sammukhā āyasmā udāyī yāvatatiyakaṃ paṭikkosati, na ca me koci bhikkhu anumodati,
an5.166:9.4: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto tuṇhī ahosi:
an5.166:10.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ āmantesi:
an5.166:10.2: kaṃ pana tvaṃ udāyī, manomayaṃ kāyaṃ paccesī?ti.
an5.166:10.3: ye te bhante devā arūpino saññāmayāti.
an5.166:10.4: kinnu kho tuyhaṃ udāyī, bālassa avyattassa bhaṇitena?
an5.166:11.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
an5.166:11.2: atthi nāma ānanda, theraṃ bhikkhuṃ vihesiyamānaṃ ajjhupekkhissatha.
an5.166:11.3: na hi nāma ānanda, kāruññampi bhavissati theramhi bhikkhumhi vihesiyamānamhī?ti.
an5.166:12.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlasampanno samādhisampanno paññāsampanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyyapi vuṭṭhaheyyapi
an5.166:12.4: no ce diṭṭheva dhamme aññaṃ ārādheyya, atikkammeva kabaliṅkārāhārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyyapi vuṭṭhaheyyapi
an5.166:12.7: idaṃ vatvā sugato uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
an5.166:13.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando acirapakkantassa bhagavato yenāyasmā upavāno tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ upavānaṃ etadavoca:
an5.166:13.4: anacchariyaṃ kho panetaṃ āvuso upavāna yaṃ bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhito etadeva ārabbha udāhareyya. yathā āyasmantaṃ yevettha upavānaṃ paṭibhāseyya.
an5.166:13.6: atha kho bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhito yena upaṭṭhānasālā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ upavānaṃ etadavoca:
an5.166:14.1: katīhi nu kho upavāna, dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyocā? ti.
an5.166:14.2: pañcahi bhante, dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo ca.
an5.166:14.4: idha bhante, thero bhikkhu sīlavā hoti …pe… samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an5.166:14.6: kalyāṇavāco hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā.
an5.166:14.7: catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
an5.166:14.9: imehi kho bhante pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo cāti.
an5.166:15.2: imehi kho upavāna, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo ca.
an5.166:15.3: ime ce upavāna, pañca dhammā therassa bhikkhuno na saṃvijjeyyuṃ, kena naṃ sabrahmacārī sakkareyyuṃ garu kareyyuṃ māneyyuṃ pūjeyyuṃ - khaṇḍiccena pāliccena valittacatāya?
an5.166:15.4: yasmā ca kho upavāna, ime pañca dhammā therassa bhikkhuno saṃvijjanti, tasmā naṃ sabrahmacārī sakkaronti garukaronti mānenti pujentīti.
